event_chain.summary: Access to Microsoft Intune console, method unknown
Managed laptops and phones remotely wiped

summary: On March 11, 2026 the Iran-linked Handala group attacked medical technology maker Stryker, apparently gaining access to its Microsoft Intune device-management console and issuing remote-wipe commands that reset employees' managed Windows devices and phones in several countries, disrupting Stryker's Microsoft environment, sending thousands of workers home and knocking the Lifenet EMS platform offline. Stryker ruled out ransomware and said the actor used a non-propagating malicious file. Handala claimed to have wiped over 200,000 devices and stolen 50TB of data; both claims are unverified.
